name: fournee
description: Fournée: a theming toolkit. Colour and type by role, one recipe, many batches. Frosting (colour), Fontdant (type), kitchen (shared store, panel, recipe format, the pass), delivery (wrappers and exports).

scripts.install:fontdant: npm --prefix fontdant ci && npx --prefix fontdant playwright install chromium firefox
scripts.build: npm --prefix frosting run build && npm --prefix fontdant run build && npm --prefix delivery run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix frosting test && npm --prefix fontdant test && npm --prefix kitchen test && npm --prefix delivery test
scripts.deploy: node catalog/build.mjs && npx --prefix frosting wrangler deploy --config catalog/wrangler.jsonc
